verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://postmarkapp.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200. Its content is clearly agent-oriented: endpoint summaries, auth requirements, a test token, task-first TypeScript examples for template sends, batch handling and webhook validation, a setup-to-production repair guide, and a companion pricing.txt. Missing for 10: markdown versions of the developer docs (developer.md returns 404) and independent reports of agents actually using the llms.txt.
